messages:
tara: kicked off canary for v3-lite-int4 @2% on /v1/chat. quick smoke: long-context slice (>=1500 tokens) shows quality dip ~2.9% abs MRR vs v3-fp16.
infra-bot: deploy: canary v3-lite-int4 -> 2% (region: eu-west1) canary_id=canary-5201112222
leo: is latency or kv-cache different?
mina: latency ~same. kv-cache hit rate slightly lower on int4 path for long sequences. hallucination proxy metric up ~0.6% absolute.
tara: numbers from eval: longctx MRR_fp16=0.521, MRR_int4=0.492 => -0.029 abs. global effect ~-0.6% abs.
sam: our auto-rollback rule is abs_mrr_drop>0.015 over 10m. that exceeds threshold. why no auto-rollback? maybe windowing smoothed it.
leo: let's avoid full rollback immediately. propose route-level pin for seq>1500 to fp16 and keep int4 on short contexts.
mina: agree. also add composite gate: require mrr_longctx and hallucination_delta <0.01 to promote.
tara: applying temporary route policy: "if seq>=1500 -> model=v3-fp16" via infractl.
infra-bot: command executed: infractl route update --route=/v1/chat --condition="seq>=1500" --model=v3-fp16
sam: create incident INC-5201113000 and collect pair diffs, reranker rescoring, kv hit traces, and a small token-logit dump for 50 samples. assign to eng-ml triage.
leo: running focused eval job: jobctl run_eval --model=v3-lite-int4 --slice=longctx --kv_warmup=true --seed=7
mina: update rollout policy proposal: increase rollback_abs_threshold to 0.02 for longctx slices and add composite metric "mrr_longctx AND (hallucination_delta<0.01)". also recommend shadow rerank for 24h.
tara: noted. mina/leo own triage. i'll monitor the canary dashboard and unpin when clear. ping here with results. :thumbsup:
